test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of October 2020, who is the CEO of Google?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sundar Pichai.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Sundar Pichai**

__
 
• **Indian-American business executive**.
 
• He is the **chief executive officer of Alphabet Inc. and its subsidiary Google.**
 
• He was selected to become the CEO of Google on **August 10, 2015.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Indra Nooyi

 
• **Indian-American business executive.**
 
• **Former chairperson and chief executive officer of PepsiCo. **
 
• She has consistently ranked among the** world's 100 most powerful women.**

**Ajay Banga**

 
• **Indian-American business executive.**
 
• Currently **Vice Chairman at General Atlantic.**
 
• He was **executive chairman of Mastercard.**

**Satya Nadella**

 
• He has been the **Chief Executive Officer of Microsoft Corporation since February 4, 2014.**
 
• He joined **Microsoft in 1992 **
 
• **He **served leadership roles in both **enterprise and consumer businesses across Microsoft for over 22 years**.
